summary.text: Greg Bonnen is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 24 since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Greg Bonnen first assumed office in the Texas House in 2013, and his current term ends on January 12, 2027.
According to Ballotpedia, his 2012 campaign website highlighted quality education, securing the Texas border, economic growth, and improving the health care system.
